graph.name: Nike Social Graph Architecture with Amazon Neptune
graph.notes: Architecture of Nike's social graph processing user interest data using AWS serverless and graph database components.

nodes.name: Nike App
nodes.notes: Mobile app where users select sports interests.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Entry point for user request data.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Ingests data from API Gateway into the processing pipeline.

nodes.name: ELB
nodes.notes: Load balances incoming user preference writes.

nodes.name: Auto Scaling
nodes.notes: EC2 auto scaling fleet executing graph operations.

nodes.name: Neptune
nodes.notes: Graph database storing user relationships and interests.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Publishes interest update events to internal subscribers.

edges.notes: User preferences sent to API Gateway.
Lambda sends requests to load balancer.
ELB distributes load across EC2 Auto Scaling instances.
EC2 instances execute graph writes on Neptune database.
EC2 instances publish event notifications to SNS.
